status: design-only; no runtime geometry or surveyed interior claim
title: Donnelly House: domestic layout interpretation
units: nominal metres on a one-metre planning grid; wall axes, not finished room clearances
orientation: rear left; street/front right; north up; schematic alignment within the retained source envelope

turret.status: attached corner bay; upper blind-arcade drum is decorative

shell.dimensionStatus: Provisional game dimensions; reconcile the final 0.2m source-envelope remainder in wall/cut-end assembly before authoring.

stairBrief.principal: Return stair in the recessed stair hall; reuse the existing full-story stair kit.
stairBrief.secondary: Optional service stair, inferred; keep a back-hall/store alternative if omitted.
stairBrief.status: Design reservation only; native tread, slab-hole, handrail and body/support validation decides the implemented kit.

rooms.name: Entry parlor
rooms.use: Receive callers; conversation and music. The off-center front door enters this room.
rooms.note: Attach the turret as a reading/seating bay; keep the door-to-stair path clear.

rooms.name: Family sitting parlor
rooms.use: Daily reading and family sitting; open the paired doors for larger visits.
rooms.note: Two front parlors are documented; their proposed individual functions and connecting doors are inferred.

rooms.name: Dining room
rooms.use: Formal meals, with a direct service connection toward the kitchen and pantry.
rooms.note: Maintain a clear serving route around the furniture.

rooms.name: Study / library
rooms.use: Correspondence, accounts and quieter reading away from the front door.
rooms.note: The use is proposed; it is not a documented Donnelly room name.

rooms.name: Main stair hall
rooms.use: Connect the parlors, dining and study to the principal upstairs landing.
rooms.note: The entrance is through a parlor; this hall is set back inside the house.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.use: Cooking and household work at the rear service entrance.
rooms.note: Reserve a supported flue route; do not add a floating roof chimney.

rooms.name: Scullery / wash room
rooms.use: Dish washing and wet work next to the kitchen.
rooms.note: Stack the proposed upstairs bathroom plumbing in this service corner.

rooms.name: Dry pantry
rooms.use: Dry stores, crockery and meal preparation overflow beside the kitchen.
rooms.note: Keep this internal cupboard dry; do not claim that it has its own outside ventilation.

rooms.name: Ventilated larder
rooms.use: Preserved food and jars in a small store with an exterior ventilation opportunity.
rooms.note: This is a proposed period use; fit an outside vent/window before claiming cooling performance.

rooms.name: Service passage
rooms.use: Move meals and supplies between kitchen, pantry and back hall.
rooms.note: The service route stays independent of the receiving parlor.

rooms.name: Back hall
rooms.use: Join the rear service circulation to dining and the main stair hall.
rooms.note: No required route should pass through a locked bedroom or cupboard.

rooms.name: Optional back stair
rooms.use: A secondary route to the rear upstairs landing; alternatively a household store.
rooms.note: This stair is an explicit inference, not a discovered original feature.

rooms.name: Principal bedchamber
rooms.use: Sleeping and dressing, with a small turret sitting bay and private veranda access.
rooms.note: Keep the bay part of the chamber; it is not a detached tower room.

rooms.name: Front bedchamber
rooms.use: A second family or guest chamber; the projecting front bay gives the circular window a room behind it.
rooms.note: The 2m bay extension sits above real porch beams/posts.

rooms.name: Family bedchamber
rooms.use: A family bedroom with a side window and direct landing access.
rooms.note: Do not use a bedroom as the only path to another room.

rooms.name: Guest / family bedchamber
rooms.use: A quieter bedroom behind the front chamber.
rooms.note: Align its partitions with the dining room below where practical.

rooms.name: Principal landing
rooms.use: Independent access to all four main chambers and the rear passage.
rooms.note: Reserve the real stairwell hole, rail opening, headroom and turning space.

rooms.name: Rear guest / household chamber
rooms.use: A guest or household-worker room, depending on the fictional occupants.
rooms.note: No specific resident or servant household is asserted.

rooms.name: Shared bathroom
rooms.use: One shared bath reached from the rear corridor.
rooms.note: A period-compatible proposal; plumbing date and original fittings are unverified.

rooms.name: Linen store
rooms.use: Store bed linen and household textiles.
rooms.note: Reach it from the back-stair landing.

rooms.name: Rear corridor
rooms.use: Connect the main landing, rear chamber, shared bathroom and optional back stair.
rooms.note: The bath is accessible without walking through a bedroom.

rooms.name: Optional service landing
rooms.use: Secondary upstairs circulation if the optional service stair is built.
rooms.note: Keep the floor continuous if the back stair is omitted.

rooms.name: Gabled attic workroom
rooms.use: Mending, hobby work or trunks behind the visible gable windows.
rooms.note: Inferred use; only the part with verified standing headroom may be walkable.

rooms.name: Attic passage
rooms.use: Connect the stair landing to the gabled room within the high roof volume.
rooms.note: Clip the proposed route against the actual hipped/cross-gabled roof.

rooms.name: Attic stair landing
rooms.use: Optional continuation of the main stair to the roof space.
rooms.note: Do not expose this floor until actual body, floor-hole and roof-clearance checks pass.

rooms.name: Low eaves storage
rooms.use: Trunk and infrequently used storage at the low roof edges.
rooms.note: Not an ordinary standing route; the tower's blind upper drum also stays non-playable unless separately evidenced.
